originalTitle: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
simplifiedContent: On Friday, the Indian stock market did well, with two important measures, Sensex and Nifty, increasing by more than 0.3%. This happened because the situation in the Middle East became less tense, and people think the US Federal Reserve might not increase interest rates as much as expected. Additionally, good things happening in India, like the India-Japan Summit and improvements in the IT sector, also helped the market. This is important because it shows that the market is responding to both international and domestic events. The upward trend may continue, but we'll have to wait and see what happens on Monday.

originalTitle: Tips from Britain's ‘Own Buffett’: Timeless investing lessons for building long-term wealth
simplifiedContent: A well-known investor named Anthony Bolton, who is often compared to a very successful investor named Warren Buffett, is sharing his tips for investing in the stock market. He says that to be successful, it's more important to have a calm and disciplined approach to investing than to be extremely smart. Bolton believes in taking the time to understand the companies he invests in, being patient, and only buying high-quality companies at fair prices. He also thinks it's crucial to know when to sell an investment and to have a clear plan for why you're investing in something. By following these principles, Bolton has been able to achieve impressive returns of nearly 20% per year.

originalTitle: Cube Highways Trust plans Rs 5,000-cr IPO this month; eyes broader investor base
simplifiedContent: Cube Highways Trust is planning to raise Rs 5,000 crore through an Initial Public Offering (IPO) this month. This means they want to sell shares to the public to collect money. The company has 27 highways across India and wants to use this IPO to get more people to invest in their business. By doing this, they hope to make it easier for people to buy and sell their shares, and to allow more people to own a part of their company. This IPO is a way for the company to grow and become more stable, which could be good for investors.

originalTitle: Upcoming IPOs: Kusumgar IPO, Laser Power & Infra IPO among new issues scheduled for next week; check list here
simplifiedContent: Next week, some companies will be selling their shares to the public for the first time, which is called an Initial Public Offering (IPO). Two main companies, Kusumgar and Laser Power & Infra, will be selling shares to raise over ₹1,392 crore. Additionally, two smaller companies, Happy Steels and Devson Catalyst, will also be selling shares to raise up to ₹67.34 crore. This matters because it gives investors a chance to buy into these companies and potentially make money if they do well. These IPOs are scheduled to open next week, allowing investors to participate and buy shares in these companies.

originalTitle: Expert view: Q1FY27 results likely to remain muted, recovery from Q2 onwards, says Vinod Nair
simplifiedContent: An expert named Vinod Nair thinks that the results for the first quarter of the financial year 2027 will not be very good. However, he believes that things will start to get better from the second quarter onwards. This is because even though the market is a bit uncertain right now, there are still some positive signs, such as people showing interest in buying stocks in areas that have not done well so far this year. This means that some investors are selling their stocks to make a profit, but others are looking to buy in different areas. Overall, the tone of the market is still somewhat positive, which could be a good sign for investors.

originalTitle: Mcap of 6 of top-10 most valued firms surges by  ₹1 lakh crore; Airtel, Bajaj Finance top gainers
simplifiedContent: The Indian stock market had a good week, with the main indexes (BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty) going up in value. The value of the top 10 most valuable companies also increased, with 6 of them gaining a total of ₹1 lakh crore. Airtel and Bajaj Finance were the biggest winners. This matters because it shows that the stock market is doing well, which can be good news for people who have invested in these companies. Overall, the market gained about 0.86-0.89% in value over the week.
